# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/esm
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm

## File: facebookresearch_esm/examples/lm-design/lm_design.py

Prompts

```
['run the Designer class to design protein sequences using ESM language model and structure prediction', 'run calc_sequence_loss to compute masked language model pseudo log-likelihood loss for protein sequences', 'run calc_structure_loss to compute cross-entropy loss between predicted and target protein structure coordinates', 'run calc_total_loss to aggregate weighted sequence structure and ngram losses for protein design optimization', 'run init_schedulers to create and register learning rate schedulers for protein design optimization stages']
```

Usage

```
{'run_Designer_sequence_design': 'run the Designer class to design protein sequences using ESM language model and structure prediction', 'run_calc_sequence_loss': 'run calc_sequence_loss to compute masked language model pseudo log-likelihood loss for protein sequences', 'run_calc_structure_loss': 'run calc_structure_loss to compute cross-entropy loss between predicted and target protein structure coordinates', 'run_calc_total_loss': 'run calc_total_loss to aggregate weighted sequence structure and ngram losses for protein design optimization', 'run_init_schedulers': 'run init_schedulers to create and register learning rate schedulers for protein design optimization stages'}
```
